title: Element 115 used to amplify gravity

tellings.quote: uh they according to Bob Lazar, they didn't I don't remember him telling me this, but according to Bob Lazar, they also use element 115 sometimes to amplify the the gravitational effect.

plain: Element 115, a very heavy element made in laboratories, is said to have been used inside captured alien craft to boost their gravity effect. Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants, repeats this from Bob Lazar, a man who has said he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada. Colbern adds that he does not remember Lazar telling him this himself, only that it is Lazar's claim.
